inputs.description: Path to the .wav under samples/ (e.g., samples/my-tone.wav)

tasks.label: Analyze: Prepare output dir
args: $base = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension('${input:wavFile}'); $out = Join-Path 'analysis' $base; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null; Write-Host "Output dir: $out"

tasks.label: Analyze: Spectrogram
tasks.detail: Render a log-frequency spectrogram PNG via FFmpeg (showspectrumpic) into analysis/<basename>/spectrogram.png

tasks.label: Analyze: Loudness
args: $base = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension('${input:wavFile}'); $out = Join-Path 'analysis' $base; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null; ffmpeg -hide_banner -nostats -i '${input:wavFile}' -af 'ebur128=peak=true+sample' -f null - 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'loudness.txt')
tasks.detail: Capture EBU R128 loudness (LUFS, true peak, RMS) via FFmpeg into analysis/<basename>/loudness.txt

tasks.label: Analyze: Spectral Stats
args: $base = [System.IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension('${input:wavFile}'); $out = Join-Path 'analysis' $base; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null; $sox = (Get-Command sox -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source; if (-not $sox) { $sox = Get-ChildItem -Path "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Packages\ChrisBagwell.SoX_*" -Recurse -Filter 'sox.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName }; if (-not $sox) { Write-Error 'sox.exe not found on PATH or in WinGet packages'; exit 1 }; & $sox '${input:wavFile}' -n stat 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath (Join-Path $out 'sox-stat.txt')
tasks.detail: Capture SoX stat report (amplitude, RMS, crest factor, DC offset) into analysis/<basename>/sox-stat.txt

tasks.label: Analyze: All
tasks.detail: Run spectrogram + loudness + spectral stats in sequence on the chosen .wav
